page.layout: One printed page. Main text in a single column on the right. A narrow margin on the left holds one note ("f Mat.2.") beside the line "sentata". No catchword.

main_text.p: paulò accuratiùs rimemur vestigia, actionum momenta eventilemus[?], singulas singulae aetatis discutiamus particulas, & minutias, & tot inveniemus obedientiae & patientiae symbola, quod paene eius dicta & facta habemus Scripturarum monumentis commendata. Statim à natalitijs, cum eum persequeretur, vitamque eius peteret Herodes, fugit in Ægyptum[?], tantumque abfuit, vt Herodi eius animam quaerenti resisteret (cum tamen ex virtute Deitatis potuisse si vellet, nemo verè Christianus ambiget:) vt post Magorum dona illi prae-f Mat.2.sentata, {f}holocausto infantum pro suo nomine oblato primo glorificari voluit, neque hunc sanguinem pro se effusum, vel ipse vindicauit, vel Bethleemiticos suos conterraneos, quorum erant infantes trucidati, aduersus Herodem infanticidam concitauit.

Herodi huic Patri, & eius nominis primo, successerunt eius filij, vt in regimine sic in impietate: in Iudaea Archilaus, in Galilaea verò Herodes cognominatus Antipas, siue Tetrarcha; quorum posterior Christi praecursorem, quod

page.notes: Ornamental marks before "Archilaus" and "Antipas" are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "eventilemus" (printed "euentilemus"), "Ægyptum" (printed as "Eegyptum"), and the running head's right-hand part, printed as "LIBI I" (read as "LIB. I"). "Herodes" in the first paragraph is set in italic; the second "Herodes" is roman. The left-page number 54 is at top left. A partial neighbouring page at the right edge is ignored. The paragraph ends mid-sentence at the foot ("quod") and continues on the next page.
